9-UNITNING BEShINChI BETI (66-bet).

Yuqorida chapda TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq '9' va 'A World of Wonders'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Writing (Project)': 'Use the information and the pictures in the Photo File section to write descriptions of the two landmarks.'
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Reading & Listening'.
16) 'Circle the correct answers.' 1 At a gallery you can see ... a works of art b shops. 2 The OPENING OF A GALLERY is ... a the hours a gallery is open to members of the public b the first day a gallery can be visited by the public. 3 ADMISSION is ... a money paid by visitors to enter a place b money offered to a museum by the rich. 4 The MEMBERS OF A MUSEUM SOCIETY are ... a museum staff b people who help the museum.
17) Kasseta belgisi: 'Read the questions, then listen and circle the correct answers.' 1 When is the opening of Shelby Museum's new Whittaker Gallery? a 8th March at 6 pm b 18th March at 6 pm. 2 Who will open the gallery? a the Mayor of Shelby b Mrs Whittaker. 3 Which collection will be on display in the gallery? a the Indian b the Oriental. 4 What are the opening hours at the museum? a 9 am to 6 pm daily b 9 am to 6:30 pm daily. 5 What do they charge for admission for adults? a £1.00 b £2.50. 6 What are visitors not allowed to take into the museum? a cameras b food.

O'NG USTUN:
18) 'Read the newspaper article and fill in the gaps with the verbs in brackets, using the passive.' GAZETA MAQOLASI (och ko'k, yirtiq): qizil-jigarrang sarlavha 'NEW GALLERY FOR SHELBY MUSEUM'. Matn: 'Members of the public 1) ...... (invite) to the opening of Shelby Museum's new Whittaker Gallery next Wednesday, 18th March, at 6 pm. The gallery, on the top floor of the museum, 2) ...... (complete) in February, and 3) ...... (will/open) by the Mayor of Shelby. The gallery 4) ...... (build) to display the Oriental Collection, which 5) ...... (give) to Shelby Museum by Mrs Whittaker in 1998. The collection 6) ...... (have/reorganise), and many paintings and statues 7) ...... (have not/show) to the public before. Opening hours at the museum are from 9 am to 6 pm daily. Admission is £2.50 for adults and £1.00 for children. Members of the Shelby Museum Society 8) ...... (admit) free of charge. Please note that cameras 9) ...... (not/allow) inside the museum.'
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Take notes under these headings, then use your notes to talk about the opening of the Whittaker Gallery.' Ko'k: opening day - to be opened by - reason it was built - the collection - opening hours - admission
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Communication: Asking for Information'.
19) Kasseta belgisi: 'Fill in the missing words, then listen and check. In pairs, act out a similar dialogue about the Tower of London.' A: Shelby Museum Information Desk. Can I 1) ...... you? B: Yes, please. Could you 2) ...... me what the museum's opening hours are? A: Certainly. Opening hours are from 9 am to 6 pm daily. B: Can I 3) ...... photographs of the collection? A: I'm 4) ...... not, madam. Cameras are not allowed inside the museum. B: I see. Oh, and one more thing - how much does it 5) ...... to get in? A: Admission is £2.50 for adults and £1.00 for children. Members of the Shelby Museum Society are admitted free of charge.
   YaShIL QUTI (Tower Bridge surati bilan): 'Tower of London Information Desk' - Opening hours: Monday - Saturday 9 am - 6 pm - cameras allowed; admission: adults £10.50, children £6.90

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '66'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the newspaper article and fill in the gaps with the verbs in brackets, using the passive.
exercises.instructionUz: Gazeta maqolasini o'qing va bo'sh joylarni qavsdagi fe'llar bilan majhul nisbatda to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MAQOLA:

  'NEW GALLERY FOR SHELBY MUSEUM
  Members of the public ARE INVITED to
  the opening of Shelby Museum's new
  Whittaker Gallery next Wednesday,
  18th March, at 6 pm. The gallery, on
  the top floor of the museum, WAS
  COMPLETED in February, and WILL BE
  OPENED by the Mayor of Shelby. The
  gallery WAS BUILT to display the
  Oriental Collection, which WAS GIVEN
  to Shelby Museum by Mrs Whittaker in
  1998. The collection HAS BEEN
  REORGANISED, and many paintings and
  statues HAVE NOT BEEN SHOWN to the
  public before. Opening hours at the
  museum are from 9 am to 6 pm daily.
  Admission is £2.50 for adults and
  £1.00 for children. Members of the
  Shelby Museum Society ARE ADMITTED
  free of charge. Please note that
  cameras ARE NOT ALLOWED inside the
  museum.'


⚠ ZAMON IShORALARI:

  1 hozir taklif → are invited
  2 'in February' → was completed
  3 'will' → will be opened
  4 qurilgan (o'tmish) → was built
  5 'in 1998' → was given
  6 'have' → has been reorganised
  7 'have not' + 'before' → have
    not been shown
  8 umumiy qoida → are admitted
  9 umumiy qoida → are not allowed


⚠ 'FREE OF CHARGE':

  = bepul.
  ⚠ 'free' ham bepul, ham erkin.


⚠ 'TO ADMIT':

  = kiritmoq, kirishga ruxsat bermoq.
  ⚠ 'admission' - shu fe'ldan.


⚠ 'PLEASE NOTE THAT':

  = e'tibor bering.
  ⚠ Rasmiy e'lonlarda.


⚠ 'TO REORGANISE':

  = qayta tashkil qilmoq.
  ⚠ Britaniya imlosi '-ise'.

items.textEn: Members of the public 1) ___ (invite) to the opening ...
The gallery ... 2) ___ (complete) in February, ...
... and 3) ___ (will/open) by the Mayor of Shelby.
The gallery 4) ___ (build) to display the Oriental Collection, ...
... which 5) ___ (give) to Shelby Museum by Mrs Whittaker in 1998.
items.whyUz:
⚠ PAST SIMPLE majhul: was + given.
⚠ give - gave - GIVEN.

items.textEn: The collection 6) ___ (have/reorganise), ...
items.whyUz:
⚠ PRESENT PERFECT majhul: has BEEN +
reorganised.

items.textEn: ... and many paintings and statues 7) ___ (have not/show) to the public before.
items.whyUz:
⚠ have not BEEN + shown (ko'plik → have).
⚠ show - showed - SHOWN.

items.textEn: Members of the Shelby Museum Society 8) ___ (admit) free of charge.
Please note that cameras 9) ___ (not/allow) inside the museum.
items.whyUz:
⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE majhul inkor: are NOT +
allowed.

modelAnswers: The Whittaker Gallery will be opened next Wednesday, 18th March, at 6 pm.
It will be opened by the Mayor of Shelby.
The gallery was built to display the Oriental Collection, which was given to the museum by Mrs Whittaker in 1998.
The collection has been reorganised, and many paintings and statues have not been shown to the public before.
The museum is open from 9 am to 6 pm daily.
Admission is £2.50 for adults and £1.00 for children, and members of the Museum Society are admitted free of charge.
modelAnswersUz: Whittaker galereyasi kelasi chorshanba, 18-mart, soat 18:00 da ochiladi.
Galereya Sharq kolleksiyasini namoyish qilish uchun qurilgan; kolleksiyani 1998 yilda Whittaker xonim muzeyga bergan.
Kolleksiya qayta tashkil qilingan va ko'p rasmlar va haykallar ilgari ommaga ko'rsatilmagan.
Muzey har kuni 9:00 dan 18:00 gacha ochiq.
Kirish kattalar uchun 2.50 funt, bolalar uchun 1.00 funt; muzey jamiyati a'zolari bepul kiradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing words, then listen and check.
exercises.instructionUz: Tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tinglab tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MA'LUMOT STOLIDA.


TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  A: Shelby Museum Information Desk.
     Can I HELP you?
  B: Yes, please. Could you TELL me
     what the museum's opening hours
     are?
  A: Certainly. Opening hours are
     from 9 am to 6 pm daily.
  B: Can I TAKE photographs of the
     collection?
  A: I'm AFRAID not, madam. Cameras
     are not allowed inside the
     museum.
  B: I see. Oh, and one more thing -
     how much does it COST to get in?
  A: Admission is £2.50 for adults
     and £1.00 for children. Members
     of the Shelby Museum Society are
     admitted free of charge.


⚠ MA'LUMOT SO'RASh QOLIPLARI:

  'Could you tell me what ... are?'
  ⚠ BILVOSITA SAVOL: 'what the hours
  ARE' - ega+kesim tartibi (savol
  tartibi EMAS!).
  'Can I ...?' - ruxsat
  'How much does it cost to ...?'


⚠ 'AN INFORMATION DESK':

  = ma'lumot stoli.


⚠ 'I SEE':

  = tushundim.


⚠ 'ONE MORE THING':

  = yana bir narsa.


⚠ 'TO GET IN':

  = kirmoq.

items.question: A: Tower of London Information Desk. Can I help you? — B: Yes, please. Could you tell me what the opening hours are?
items.answer: A: Certainly. Opening hours are from 9 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday.

items.question: B: Can I take photographs inside the Tower?
items.answer: A: Yes, you can. Cameras are allowed.

items.question: B: I see. Oh, and one more thing - how much does it cost to get in?
items.answer: A: Admission is £10.50 for adults and £6.90 for children.
